name: Why is proper surface preparation important for exterior painting?

mainEntity.name: Why is proper surface preparation important for exterior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper surface preparation is crucial for the longevity and appearance of an exterior paint job. Without adequate cleaning, scraping, sanding, and priming, new paint will not adhere correctly, leading to premature peeling, cracking, or bubbling. Good prep ensures a smooth, uniform surface for the paint, maximizing its durability and aesthetic appeal for years to come, especially in varying climates like Mission Viejo.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper surface preparation ensures paint adhesion and durability, preventing issues like peeling and cracking, and extending the paint's lifespan.
